name: riah-todo
description: Today's list as a note by the Windows clock, or as a full page on Mac. Click the tray icon (Windows) or open the board (Mac), tick things off. One JSON file, no cloud.
//: private: this is an app people download from GitHub, not an npm package. It stops an accidental `npm publish`; remove it only if we deliberately choose npm distribution.

scripts.//test: Listed explicitly on purpose. A glob needs either a shell that expands it (pwsh does not) or Node 22+ (the runner had 20), and CI was red on every run while it passed locally. Add new *.test.mjs files here.
scripts.test: node --test test/store.test.mjs test/threads.test.mjs test/safety.test.mjs test/finished.test.mjs test/sections.test.mjs test/sleep.test.mjs && node test/fonts-and-mac.mjs
scripts.check: npm test && npm run smoke:race && npm run smoke:server && npm run smoke:guard && npm run smoke:note
scripts.check:ci: npm test && npm run smoke:race && npm run smoke:server
